reports.title: Délibération N°007/CU/L/2021 du 31 mars 2021 (compte administratif 2020 et budget 2021)
reports.publisher: Conseil Communal, Commune Urbaine de Labé, Guinée
reports.description: Commune Urbaine de Labé's own published council deliberation, verified directly on the commune's own official site. FY2020 compte administratif (execution) for the fonctionnement section: "Prévision 2.431.187.305 Réalisation 1.071.529.354 Reste à réaliser 937.773.651" (GNF) in revenue, against operating expenditures "Prévision 972.474.922 Réalisation 432.774.830"; total general expenditure execution "Prévision 7.159.901.643 Réalisation 1.957.309.108"; year-end balance "Solde au 31 Décembre 2020: 16.264.970" GNF. The council adopted a balanced FY2021 budget of "Sept Milliards Cinq Cent Dix Millions Sept Cent Soixante Mille Cent Vingt Trois (7.510.760.123) Francs Guinéens" — a real, named-commune budget figure from the commune's own primary deliberation record, distinct from and more current than the PDL 2025-2029 document flagged in the prior round.
reports.cadence_note: One-off council deliberation record for the 2020 exercice and the 2021 budget.

reports.title: Manuel de Procédures du Fonds National de Développement Local (FNDL)
reports.publisher: Agence Nationale de Financement des Collectivités Locales (ANAFIC), Guinée
reports.description: ANAFIC's own operating manual for the FNDL transfer mechanism (the operational fund created under gn-code-collectivites-locales-2017's Art. 484/492 framework), verified directly via download from ANAFIC's own site. States the allocation formula in full capitals for emphasis in the source document: "ELLES SONT INDEXEES SUR LA POPULATION AVEC UN MONTANT FIXE PAR HABITANT POUR TOUTES LES COLLECTIVITES LOCALES EXCEPTE CELLES DE CONAKRY" [Allocations are indexed to population with a fixed per-inhabitant amount for all local collectivities EXCEPT those of Conakry] — confirming a population-based per-capita formula for every commune in Guinea outside the capital, with Conakry treated under a separate (unspecified in the excerpt reviewed) mechanism. The manual frames the mechanism's purpose as ensuring "le principe de développement équilibré et harmonieux du territoire, garantie d'une meilleure redistribution de la richesse nationale."
reports.cadence_note: One-off foundational procedural instrument, currently in force.

reports.title: Guide Citoyen de la Loi de Finances Initiale (LFI) 2021
reports.description: Guinea's own citizen's budget guide, verified directly via download from the Ministère du Budget's own site. States the national ANAFIC allocation for FY2021: "la dotation en faveur de l'ANAFIC s'élevant à 402,63 milliards GNF est destinée à la mise en œuvre du programme d'appui pour le financement des investissements des collectivités locales." Separately breaks down a distinct local-authority transfer line: "3,79 Mds répartis entre les régions administratives (Boké, Faranah, Kankan, Kindia, Labé, Mamou et N'zérékoré) et 10,04 milliards pour l'ensemble des collectivités décentralisées" — a combined 13.83 billion GNF region/commune split, distinct from and additional to the 402.63bn ANAFIC investment-support envelope.
reports.cadence_note: One-off annual citizen's-budget-guide publication; this is the LFI-2021 edition.

dependencies.basis: The FNDL manuel de procédures operationalizes the state-to-collectivités dotation/subvention mechanisms named in Articles 484 and 492 of the Code Révisé des Collectivités Locales, matching the already-established gn-anafic-decree -> gn-code-collectivites-locales-2017 edge in af-guinea.json (same relationship, corroborated by a second ANAFIC-published document).
